# VexaTool

> Free online PDF, image, QR, and calculator tools. 100% browser-based, no signup, no file uploads.

VexaTool offers 50+ free utilities that run entirely client-side in your browser. Files never leave your device, ensuring privacy for sensitive documents like Aadhaar, PAN, contracts, and medical records.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of all free online tools.
- [All Tools](/all-tools): Browse the full catalog of 50+ tools.
- [About](/about-us): Mission, team, and privacy commitment.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the VexaTool team.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides on PDF editing, image processing, and productivity.

## Categories

- [PDF Tools](/pdf-tools): Merge, split, compress, convert, sign, and protect PDFs.
- [Image Tools](/image-tools): Resize, compress, convert, and remove backgrounds.
- [Calculator Tools](/calculator-tools): EMI, GST, BMI, age, percentage, and unit conversions.
- [QR Tools](/qr-tools): Generate and scan QR codes with logo and label support.
- [Utility Tools](/utility-tools): Word counter, PIN code finder, currency converter.

## Popular Tools

- [Merge PDF](/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one file.
- [Compress PDF](/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF size without losing quality.
- [Split PDF](/split-pdf): Extract or separate PDF pages.
- [Sign PDF](/sign-pdf): Add signatures to PDF documents.
- [QR Code Generator](/qr-code-generator): Create QR codes with logos and labels.
- [Image Resizer](/image-resizer): Resize images for social media and print.
- [Background Remover](/background-remover): Remove image backgrounds in-browser.
- [EMI Calculator](/emi-calculator): Calculate loan EMIs instantly.
